description: This PHP source file provides the web interface and client-side validation for adding a new Dynamic DNS (DDNS) configuration in a network management web GUI. It includes HTML markup, embedded JavaScript for form validation and dynamic UI interaction, and PHP code for populating form options and localization.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds new hostname input fields in the form for adding multiple hostnames.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes a hostname input field from the form.
